description: Show what FixMyScan will do before converting: before-and-after images of 3 pages of the user's own book. Use it when the user wants to see the result first. Give the same source as fix_scan, or the scan_id of a book not yet converted. The first call returns at once; call again with the scan_id after about ten seconds for the images. To convert after the preview, call fix_scan with upload_id set to the scan_id.

file.description: A PDF or DjVu file the user attached in this chat.

download_url.description: Where the attached file can be downloaded.

output.description: bw: sharp black and white, best on e-ink. grey: gentle greyscale.

scan_id.description: The scan_id fix_scan or list_my_scans gave.

source_url.description: A public https link to the PDF or DjVu file.

split_spreads.description: Split scans of two facing pages into single pages.

trim_margins.description: Crop each page to its text block. Covers and picture pages stay whole.

upload_id.description: The upload_id from create_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the file.

name: preview_scan
title: Preview a scan
